title: An operator creates a work item, finds it in the work list and releases it
description: POST /api/work creates an item with its criteria, replaying the create under the same idempotency key returns the same item, GET /api/work lists it, and POST /api/work/:id/ready releases it from the backlog. When the target is a checkout's e2e serve, its seed file is keyed by its own port, so another serve in the checkout never overwrites or removes it (GY-3666).
